prose: Anthropic launched the Claude Frontier Academy with a $100M commitment to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by 2028. It includes a residency built around a simulated enterprise deployment, testing judgment rather than isolated technical skills.
Consulting firms such as Accenture say they will send engineers through it, describing forward-deployed engineers as people who work inside client workflows to put AI into governed production.
highlights: $100M to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by 2028.
Residency uses a simulated enterprise deployment.
Aimed at the gap between AI pilots and production.
